title: Validate request hosts in domain-based i18n routing
body:
## Changes

- Validates `Host` and `X-Forwarded-Host` against `security.allowedDomains` before using either header to select a locale in domain-based i18n routing.
- Ignores untrusted forwarded hosts while preserving existing `Host` routing when `allowedDomains` is not configured.

## Testing

- Adds unit coverage for allowed, rejected, missing, malformed, and comma-separated forwarded host values, plus `Host` validation behavior.
- Updates domain-based i18n app tests to configure allowed domains and adds an end-to-end regression case for a rejected forwarded locale domain.

## Docs

- No docs update needed because this aligns domain-based i18n routing with the existing documented `security.allowedDomains` behavior.
